persons.name: Śivarāma
persons.evidence: śivarāmo likhac ... śivarāmana saṃpūrṇṇana coyā juroṃ

date.as_written: vidhuvāhamunauvarṣe śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣake | ṣaṣṭhyān tithau hastaṛkṣe śivayoge ravau dine || ... samvat 771 śrāvaṇaśuklaṣaṣṭhī(2)tithi(!) hastanakṣatra (!) śivayoge ādityavāra (!)

notes: The chronogram 'vidhuvāhamunau' corresponds to vidhu (1), vāha (7), muni (7) = NS 771, confirming the numerical date 771.
